jobs.title: Chargé·e de projets marketing, plateformes de contenu
jobs.desc:
La personne titulaire du poste est responsable de la stratégie visuelle et de la mise en marché de l’offre de contenu sur l’ensemble des plateformes numériques et télévisuelles. À ce titre, elle développe et déploie des initiatives visant à maximiser la visibilité, la découvrabilité et la performance des contenus, tout en assurant une expérience de marque cohérente à travers l’ensemble des points de contact.
 Agissant comme personne-ressource entre les équipes internes, les partenaires de contenu et les partenaires externes, elle coordonne la réalisation de projets promotionnels, veille au respect des engagements commerciaux et contribue à la mise en valeur de l’offre sur l’ensemble des plateformes.
 Grâce à une approche alliant créativité, sens des affaires et orientation vers les résultats, la personne titulaire du poste participe activement à l’atteinte des objectifs d’affaires, à la croissance de l’engagement de la clientèle ainsi qu’au rayonnement des plateformes et des marques
 Principales responsabilités : 
 Création visuelle et mise en marché
 Développer et faire évoluer la stratégie visuelle des plateformes de contenu.
 Concevoir et produire les visuels promotionnels destinés aux plateformes numériques, aux applications, aux infolettres et aux campagnes marketing.
 Contribuer au déploiement des stratégies de mise en marché des contenus CVOD, SVOD, TVOD ainsi que des applications.
 Assurer la visibilité, la mise en valeur et la performance de l’offre de contenu sur l’ensemble des plateformes.
 Rédiger, coordonner et diffuser les infolettres dédiées aux contenus.
 Gestion commerciale et partenariats
 Veiller au respect des ententes commerciales et des obligations contractuelles.
 Assurer la réalisation des initiatives de visibilité, de promotion et de monétisation prévues avec les partenaires.
 Effectuer les suivis commerciaux auprès des partenaires stratégiques et collaborer au développement d’initiatives promotionnelles.
 Innovation et amélioration continue
 Participer à des projets d’innovation, notamment les lancements de plateformes, les initiatives de repositionnement de marque et l’intégration de nouveaux formats.
 Collaborer à l’évolution des plateformes, des outils et des fonctionnalités liés à la présentation et à la gestion des contenus.
 Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de l’expérience utilisateur·trice et à l’optimisation des processus.
Diplôme universitaire de premier cycle en marketing, en communications, en design graphique, en administration ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience jugée équivalente.
 Minimum de trois à cinq ans d’expérience en marketing de contenu, en mise en marché, en gestion de projets ou en création visuelle.
 Expérience en création, en adaptation et en déploiement de matériel promotionnel pour des plateformes numériques.
 Bonne connaissance du secteur des médias, du divertissement, du streaming ou des plateformes de contenu.
 Grand intérêt pour l’industrie télévisuelle et cinématographique, le marché de la télédistribution ainsi que la programmation et la distribution de contenu au Canada et à l’international.
 Bonne connaissance des principes de design graphique, d’expérience utilisateur (UX) et de marketing numérique.
 Maîtrise des logiciels de création graphique (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva ou outils équivalents), ainsi que des règles de typographie et de mise en page.
 Connaissance des outils d’intelligence artificielle générative et capacité à les utiliser dans le respect des politiques de l’entreprise.
 Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office, particulièrement Excel et PowerPoint.
 Excellente maîtrise du français, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.
 Maîtrise de l’anglais (parlé et écrit) de niveau avancé. La personne titulaire du poste sera appelée à collaborer avec des partenaires externes anglophones et à adapter des visuels, des contenus promotionnels et des infolettres dans les deux langues.
 Expérience en gestion de partenariats et en suivi d’ententes commerciales, un atout.

 Bénéficie de  rabais sur les services Vidéotron allant jusqu’à 80%  ainsi qu’auprès de nos partenaires ;
 Tire profit de  l’horaire 4 saisons  et répartis tes heures sur 4.5 jours (selon les besoins opérationnels) ;

 Développe ton plein potentiel et imagine tout ce que tu peux devenir au sein de la famille Québecor par le biais de  nos diverses opportunités de carrière  ;
 Saisis l’occasion de collaborer au succès d’une entreprise qui partage tes valeurs en  soutenant entre autres près de 400 organismes  !

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Cohere APIs and DevEx
jobs.desc:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!




WHY THIS ROLE?

In this role, you will manage the team that owns the Cohere inference APIs and SDKs, as well as the Cohere Dashboard, where customers can access our models, manage teams, and audit billing. You will collaborate with internal partners to craft a delightful, intuitive, and unified experience across everything the Cohere APIs and Cohere Dashboard have to offer. As a hands-on leader, you will shift seamlessly between roles as mentor, strategist, and technologist to guide the team toward shared success.

Join our team of builders who are shaping the future of large language models!




AS AN ENGINEERING MANAGER OF THE COHERE APIS AND DEVEX TEAM, YOU WILL:

 - Manage, mentor, and grow a talented and enthusiastic team of backend and full-stack software engineers

 - Participate in model releases and develop new API capabilities

 - Work closely with Modelling and Model Serving teams

 - Collaborate with UX designers to ensure customers have an easy and delightful time managing teams, API keys, billing and configurations.

 - Oversee and contribute to open source projects
   
   


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You have experience managing engineering teams and a proven track record of delivering high-quality software

 - You have experience shipping products with a large number of stakeholders

 - You’re comfortable with the front and back end of the stack, and have previously worked with Go, Next.js, TypeScript, and React

 - You are passionate about recruiting and growing people and teams

 - You are passionate about building rapport with your team and you prioritize 1:1s

 - You have excellent communication skills and believe that documentation is a great way to get feedback and discuss technical implementations and designs

 - You have the ability to take complex needs and goals and develop easy to understand explanations for all audiences

 - You’re excited about AI and have the motivation to scale a company




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

As part of our Manufacturing team, you’ll bring innovation to life, transforming visionary designs into world-class training solutions. You’ll play a key role in assembling, refining, and delivering products that support aviation and defence missions worldwide. Every detail you shape contributes to safety, precision, and performance.                                                                                                           
 At CAE, our manufacturing experts transform visionary designs into reality, building state-of-the-art simulators for our Civil Aviation and Defense & Security divisions. As part of the team driving innovation on the production floor, every day presents an opportunity to turn ideas into world-class products, from assembly and testing to final production and deployment.
 By bringing your expertise, you will help shape the future of training and safety with precision, ensuring our customers are prepared for the most critical moments. As all the pieces come together, each carefully assembled component contributes to the strength of the final product, advancing CAE's mission of quality, integrity, and excellence around the world.
 CAE's Montreal manufacturing center is unique and highly complex. Its operations enable CAE to manufacture, assemble, and integrate some of the most advanced flight simulators available on the market. The broad simulation product portfolio and the large number of airline customers served create a continuous flow of operational challenges that must be addressed daily. The variety and complexity of these requests require the expertise of a dynamic and innovative team: Operations Support. Through its technical expertise and strong operational presence, the team also plays a key role in influencing future engineering designs.
 The Engineering Manager, Operations Support is responsible for leading a specialized team of mechanical and electrical engineers. This role ensures the team has the necessary resources and support to effectively meet operational requirements while maintaining strong relationships with internal customers. The incumbent will drive continuous improvement initiatives, monitor operational performance metrics, and foster a customer-focused culture while serving as a positive and influential leader.
 Your Challenges 
 Lead, coach, and supervise the Operations Support team by planning, organizing, and managing departmental activities to achieve optimal results and performance.
 Serve as the primary point of contact between Manufacturing Engineering and Operations, managing the escalation of operational issues.
 Define, develop, and implement the vision and strategic direction of the Operations Support department.
 Oversee day-to-day Operations Support activities to ensure service commitments and performance objectives are met.
 Establish, manage, and monitor budgets related to Operations Support activities.
 Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements and lead the implementation of process enhancements across the organization.
 Act as a technical expert, guiding the team through complex problem-solving situations and managing project-related risks.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree (or College Diploma) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
 Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in team leadership, management, or supervision, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.
 Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and Power BI.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Inspiring and people-focused leader.
 Strong coaching and mentoring abilities.
 Excellent problem-solving skills.
 Ability to synthesize and communicate information effectively at all organizational levels.
 Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage changing priorities.
 Strong attention to detail and rigor.
 High degree of adaptability in a rapidly evolving environment.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both French and English, with strong interpersonal abilities.
 Why Join CAE? 
 Professional and collaborative work environment.
 Challenging and rewarding projects.
 Team-oriented culture.
 Competitive benefits package.
 On-site cafeteria.
 Free parking.

 At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success.

jobs.desc:
The role can be located in Montreal, Canada, or in any relevant location within Europe. 
 We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking leader to establish and lead CAE's Safety & Quality Intelligence capability. This role will transform fragmented Safety and Quality data into actionable intelligence that supports decision-making, risk management, operational excellence, and regulatory confidence.
 Working across Operations and the Civil and Defense & Security business units, the successful candidate will lead the consolidation and standardization of Safety and Quality analytics, establish enterprise-wide metrics and reporting frameworks, and help shape the future Global Safety & Quality Intelligence Platform.
 The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership with strong analytical expertise and is comfortable engaging with senior executives while building foundational processes and capabilities. This is a unique opportunity to influence how CAE leverages analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to strengthen governance, improve performance, and foster a proactive, data-driven Safety & Quality culture.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead the consolidation and standardization of Safety & Quality analytics across CAE.
 Establish and govern a robust Safety & Quality data framework to improve consistency, reliability, and decision-making.
 Define enterprise-wide metrics, KPIs, reporting standards, and data taxonomies.
 Develop executive dashboards, risk intelligence, and performance insights to support global Safety & Quality governance.
 Partner with the Safety & Quality Systems Governance function to develop the Global Safety & Quality Intelligence Platform, ensuring technology solutions align with business objectives.
 Define requirements for predictive analytics, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities within the platform.
 Lead and develop a team of analytics and intelligence professionals.
 Collaborate with leaders across Global Safety, Global Operational Governance, Operations, Manufacturing, and the Civil and Defense & Security business units.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Business Intelligence, Information Systems, Quality Management, Engineering, Aviation Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
 Minimum of 8 years of experience in analytics, data governance, intelligence, quality management, safety management, compliance monitoring, or continuous improvement.
 Demonstrated experience leading analytics, reporting, or intelligence initiatives across multiple business units or operational environments.
 Proven experience establishing and managing KPI frameworks, reporting standards, metrics, taxonomies, and dashboard structures.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Power BI or equivalent platforms.
 Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and reporting best practices.
 Experience working within regulated environments, preferably in aerospace, engineering, manufacturing, safety, quality, or compliance-related functions.
 Proven ability to influence stakeholders and lead change in a global, matrixed organization.
 Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
 Demonstrated experience leading and developing professional teams.
 Professional certifications in analytics, data management, quality, safety, auditing, project management, AI, or business intelligence.
 Experience standardizing analytics across multiple systems, business units, or geographic regions.
 Knowledge of aviation safety, quality assurance, compliance monitoring, Quality Management Systems (QMS), Safety Management Systems (SMS), and regulatory oversight frameworks.
 Experience supporting transformation initiatives involving systems consolidation, governance modernization, or organizational change.
 Working knowledge of predictive analytics, machine learning, AI-enabled decision support, anomaly detection, model governance, and AI engineering methodologies.
 Familiarity with enterprise digital tools and technology platforms.
 Experience delivering executive-level analytics, performance insights, and governance reporting.
 Experience defining business requirements and partnering with Digital, IT, and governance teams to develop technology solutions.
 Passion for building data-driven cultures that enhance safety, quality, operational performance, regulatory confidence, and business outcomes.
 Benefits 
 Comprehensive group insurance.
 Telemedicine services.
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
 Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
 Group RRSP.
 Defined benefit pension plan.
 Sabbatical leave opportunities.
 Enhanced parental leave.

 At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success.

 Titre du poste: Gestionnaire principal de la sécurité
 À propos de Pratt & Whitney Canada 
 Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.
 Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.
 Un employeur de choix 
 Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.
 Pourquoi rejoindre l’équipe? 
 Dans ce rôle, relevant du directeur associé de la sécurité, vous serez appelé à :
 Diriger, coordonner et gérer les activités quotidiennes de sécurité afin de protéger les actifs, en faisant preuve d’initiative pour élaborer des plans d’atténuation en temps opportun.
 Superviser l’administration et la gestion des risques liés aux services de gardiennage sur les sites du Québec, qui abritent le siège des activités canadiennes de Pratt & Whitney.
 Présenter aux dirigeants de l’entreprise et aux équipes de projet des breffages, des rapports détaillés et des avis adaptés au niveau de risque, fondés sur l’analyse de renseignements de sources ouvertes et de renseignements liés à la sécurité.
 Diriger les activités de sécurité sur place lors d’événements spéciaux et assurer les services destinés aux personnalités de marque (VIP), conformément au programme de services de sécurité pour les employés clés de la Sécurité mondiale de P&W.
 Veiller au bon fonctionnement de l’ensemble des technologies et des systèmes de sécurité afin de soutenir les mesures de sécurité proactives et réactives sur chaque site. 
 Concevoir des solutions en collaboration avec d’autres programmes de l’entreprise, notamment en matière de vidéosurveillance (CCTV), de détection d’intrusion, de contrôle d’accès, de sécurité périmétrique et d’autres mesures d’atténuation des risques.
 Le poste est à temps plein du lundi au vendredi à Longueuil et s’effectue exclusivement en présentiel. 
 À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien ? 
 Coordonner et gérer les activités quotidiennes de l’équipe de sécurité, tout en assurant le respect des plus hauts standards de conformité et de service à la clientèle.
 Définir et mettre en œuvre des politiques et des procédures favorisant l’amélioration continue au sein de l’équipe.
 Surveiller les systèmes de contrôle d’accès et de vidéosurveillance, et collaborer avec les différentes parties prenantes aux projets impliquant ces systèmes.
 Présenter aux dirigeants de l’entreprise et aux équipes de projet des breffages, des rapports détaillés et des avis adaptés au niveau de risque, fondés sur les renseignements de sources ouvertes, les politiques de l’entreprise, les lignes directrices gouvernementales et les exigences du programme.
 Préparer et coordonner les événements et les visites sur les sites du Québec.
 Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ? 
 Qualifications requises 
 L’une des combinaisons suivantes de formation et d’expérience : diplôme d’études supérieures et 7 ans ou plus d’expérience dans les domaines militaire, de l’application de la loi, de la sécurité, du renseignement, de la cybersécurité ou dans un domaine connexe; OU baccalauréat et 10 ans ou plus d’expérience pertinente dans l’industrie; OU diplôme d’études collégiales et 11 ans ou plus d’expérience pertinente dans l’industrie; OU diplôme d’études secondaires, formation militaire ou formation technique et 13 ans ou plus d’expérience pertinente dans l’industrie.
 5 ans ou plus d’expérience en gestion ou en direction d’équipes.
 Maintenir un statut d’agent désigné valide dans le cadre du Programme des marchandises contrôlées du Canada.
 Qualifications souhaitées 
 Diplôme d’études collégiales dans un domaine pertinent.
 Expérience dans l’élaboration, la mise en œuvre et la gestion de programmes de sécurité d’entreprise, ainsi que dans la gestion de services de sécurité contractuels fournis par des tiers.
 Certification ASIS de professionnel de la protection certifié (Certified Protection Professional – CPP).
 Expérience avec les systèmes Chubb, Avigilon et Automatic Systems.
 Expérience en réglementation du commerce mondial et en marquage à l’exportation.
 Expérience dans le traitement discret de renseignements sensibles et confidentiels.
 Expérience dans la réalisation d’audits et le rapprochement de dossiers de sécurité.
 Capacité démontrée à élaborer des procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON) et de la documentation sur les processus.
 Expérience en coordination de projets avec des représentants gouvernementaux, des entrepreneurs et des équipes internes.
 Connaissance pratique des outils et des principes d’amélioration continue (CORE/ACE, Six Sigma).
 Capacité à travailler et à communiquer efficacement dans l’ensemble de l’organisation, ainsi qu’avec les fournisseurs et les clients, dans les deux langues officielles.
 Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une très bonne connaissance de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre, sur une base quotidienne, de la documentation et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

 Job Title: Senior Manager, Security 
 About Pratt & Whitney Canada 
 Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) is a global leader in aerospace innovation, proudly headquartered in Longueuil, Quebec, since 1928. We design and manufacture next-generation aircraft engines that power the world’s largest fleet of business, general aviation, and regional aircraft and helicopters.

 Why Join Our Team? 
 In this role, reporting to the Associate Director of Security, you will be responsible for:
 Leading, coordinating, and managing daily security operations to protect company assets, taking initiative to develop mitigation plans in a timely manner.
 Overseeing the administration and risk management of security guard services at Quebec sites, which house Pratt & Whitney’s Canadian operations headquarters.
 Delivering briefings, detailed reports, and risk-based recommendations to company leadership and project teams, based on the analysis of open-source intelligence and security-related intelligence.
 Leading on-site security operations for special events and providing services for high-profile individuals (VIPs), in accordance with P&W Global Security’s Key Employee Security Services Program.
 Ensuring that all security technologies and systems remain operational to support proactive and reactive security measures at each site.
 Developing solutions in collaboration with other corporate programs, including closed-circuit television (CCTV), intrusion detection, access control, perimeter security, and other risk mitigation measures.
 This is a full-time, on-site position based in Longueuil, Monday through Friday. 
 What will your day-to-day look like? 
 Coordinating and managing the daily activities of the security team while ensuring the highest standards of compliance and customer service.
 Defining and implementing policies and procedures that promote continuous improvement within the team.
 Monitoring access control and video surveillance systems, and collaborating with various stakeholders on projects involving these systems.
 Delivering briefings, detailed reports, and risk-based recommendations to company leadership and project teams, based on open-source intelligence, corporate policies, government guidelines, and program requirements.
 Preparing and coordinating events and visits at Quebec sites.
 What Do You Need to Succeed? 
 Required Qualifications 
 One of the following combinations of education and experience: A graduate degree and 7 or more years of experience in the military, law enforcement, security, intelligence, cybersecurity, or a related field; OR A bachelor’s degree and 10 or more years of relevant industry experience; OR A college diploma and 11 or more years of relevant industry experience; OR A high school diploma, military training, or technical training and 13 or more years of relevant industry experience.
 5 or more years of experience in management or team leadership.
 Must maintain valid Designated Official status under Canada’s Controlled Goods Program.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 A college diploma in a relevant field.
 Experience developing, implementing, and managing corporate security programs, as well as managing contracted security services provided by third parties.
 ASIS Certified Protection Professional (CPP) certification.
 Experience with Chubb, Avigilon, and Automatic Systems.
 Experience with global trade regulations and export marking requirements.
 Experience handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
 Experience conducting audits and reconciling security records.
 Demonstrated ability to develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) and process documentation.
 Experience coordinating projects with government representatives, contractors, and internal teams.
 Working knowledge of continuous improvement tools and principles (CORE/ACE, Six Sigma).
 Ability to work and communicate effectively across the organization, as well as with suppliers and customers, in both official languages.
 This position is part of a French-speaking work environment, it requires a very good knowledge of English to read and understand, on a daily basis, documentation and technical terms that may emanate from international organizations, as well as to write and communicate in English with customers, suppliers or international colleagues.
 What do we offer? 
 Pension and savings plan with employer contributions
 Group insurance program
 Opportunities for advancement (career progression)
 Merit or recognition program
 Health and wellness program, including virtual health care
 Recreational and sports club

  Supervise daily operations related to the manufacturing of multiple cutting tool.

 Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde. 
 Un employeur de choix 
 Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale. 
 Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe? 
 Façonnez l’avenir de la fabrication numérique. Inspirez les talents. Transformez les ambitions en résultats concrets. 
 Vous souhaitez jouer un rôle stratégique dans la transformation numérique de nos opérations manufacturières, tout en développant une équipe talentueuse et engagée? Voici une occasion unique de laisser votre marque! 
 Relevant du directeur associé, Stratégie et transformation numérique, vous rejoindrez une équipe au cœur de l'évolution de nos pratiques manufacturières. Notre mission: connecter les personnes, les processus et les technologies afin d'accélérer l'innovation, d'améliorer la performance opérationnelle et de bâtir les capacités numériques de demain. 
 À titre de gestionnaire principal, vous aurez l'occasion de définir la vision et les priorités de la fabrication numérique, d'orienter les investissements stratégiques et de contribuer à des initiatives de transformation ayant un impact concret à l'échelle de l'organisation. 
 Vous dirigerez une équipe dynamique réunissant des professionnels d'expérience et de nouveaux talents. Votre leadership permettra de valoriser les expertises, de stimuler les idées nouvelles et de créer un environnement où la collaboration, l'autonomie et le développement professionnel sont au premier plan. 
 Joignez-vous à nous pour bâtir bien plus que des solutions numériques: contribuez à façonner l'avenir de nos opérations manufacturières et à développer les talents qui porteront cette transformation. 
 Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de  Longueuil  du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.  
 À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien? 
 Définir et faire évoluer la stratégie et la feuille de route des capacités de fabrication numérique, en assurant leur alignement avec les priorités d'affaires et les objectifs de performance manufacturière. 
 Diriger, mobiliser et développer une équipe multidisciplinaire composée de talents émergents et de professionnels chevronnés, en favorisant le mentorat, la collaboration et une culture de haute performance. 
 Orienter et prioriser le portefeuille de produits et de capacités numériques, évaluer les occasions d'investissement et maximiser la valeur générée pour l'organisation. 
 Encadrer et soutenir les responsables de produits et de chaînes de valeur afin d'assurer la cohérence des feuilles de route, des priorités et des résultats d'affaires attendus. 
 Promouvoir et piloter l'harmonisation des processus manufacturiers et des capacités numériques entre les différents sites, tout en considérant leurs réalités opérationnelles. 
 Établir et suivre les indicateurs de performance, les objectifs d'affaires et les plans de réalisation des bénéfices afin de mesurer l'impact des initiatives numériques. 
 Favoriser des relations solides, harmonieuses et collaboratives avec les partenaires de la fabrication, de l’ingénierie, de la qualité, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, des finances et des technologies numériques, en cultivant la confiance, la compréhension mutuelle et la collaboration interfonctionnelle afin d’harmoniser les priorités et de faciliter la prise de décisions stratégiques. 
 Assurer la cohérence entre la stratégie, les besoins d'affaires et la mise en œuvre des solutions, en partenariat avec les équipes responsables de la transformation, de la réalisation des projets et du développement organisationnel. 
 Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir? 
 Formation: Baccalauréat en génie, en gestion des opérations, en technologies de l'information ou dans un domaine connexe. 
 Expérience: Minimum de 10 années d'expérience pertinente en environnement manufacturier, dont au moins 5 années en gestion d'équipes, en transformation numérique ou en leadership stratégique. 
 Langues française et anglaise: Maîtrise avancée du français et de l’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit, afin de collaborer efficacement avec les équipes internes et les partenaires, tant à l’échelle locale qu’internationale. 
 Leadership et mobilisation: Expérience démontrée en gestion et en développement d'équipes multidisciplinaires, avec une capacité à inspirer, à influencer et à rallier les parties prenantes autour d'objectifs communs. 
 Vision stratégique et sens des affaires: Capacité à élaborer des stratégies et des feuilles de route, à gérer des portefeuilles de produits numériques, à prioriser les investissements et à générer des résultats d'affaires mesurables. 
 Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une très bonne connaissance de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre, sur une base quotidienne, de la documentation et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.
 Qualifications privilégiées 
 Expertise en fabrication numérique: Solide compréhension des processus manufacturiers, des technologies numériques et des systèmes de gestion du cycle de vie des produits (PLM) et des opérations manufacturières (MES/MOM). Une expérience en intégration des systèmes, en traçabilité ou en gestion des données manufacturières constitue un atout.
 Collaboration et transformation: Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en résolution de problèmes complexes et en gestion du changement, combinées à une approche axée sur l'innovation, l'harmonisation des processus et l'amélioration continue. Une expérience en environnement multisite et une connaissance des méthodologies Lean, Six Sigma ou Agile constituent des atouts.

 Job Title: Senior Manager, Digital Manufacturing Strategy & Transformation
 About Pratt & Whitney Canada 
 Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) is a global leader in aerospace innovation, proudly headquartered in Longueuil, Quebec, since 1928. We design and manufacture next-generation aircraft engines that power the world’s largest fleet of business, general aviation, and regional aircraft and helicopters. 
 For nearly 100 years, our teams have been at the forefront of propulsion technology, pushing boundaries to make flight more efficient and reliable. Our engines support missions that truly matter, from transporting people and essential goods, to enabling emergency medical services, humanitarian operations, and wildfire suppression around the world. 
 An Employer of Choice 
 Pratt & Whitney Canada was named one of Canada’s Best Employers for 2026 by Forbes, marking the 11th consecutive year the company has earned this recognition. Pratt & Whitney Canada also ranked #1 employer in the aerospace and defense industry in the country. In addition, our headquarters continues to be recognized among the top employers in the Montreal region. Together, these distinctions reinforce our reputation as an employer of choice in Montreal, across Canada, and around the world.
 Why join our team? 
 Shape the future of Digital Manufacturing. Inspire talent. Turn ambition into measurable results.
 Are you looking to play a strategic role in transforming manufacturing operations while developing a talented and engaged team? This is a unique opportunity to make a lasting impact! 
 Reporting to the Associate Director, Strategy & Digital Transformation, you will join a team at the heart of our manufacturing evolution. Our mission is to connect people, processes, and technology to accelerate innovation, improve operational performance, and build the digital capabilities of tomorrow. 
 As Senior Manager, Digital Manufacturing, you will have the opportunity to shape the vision and strategic priorities of Digital Manufacturing, influence key investment decisions, and contribute to transformation initiatives that deliver tangible value across the organization. 
 You will lead a dynamic team that brings together seasoned professionals and emerging talent. Your leadership will be instrumental in leveraging diverse expertise, encouraging fresh perspectives, and creating an environment where collaboration, empowerment, and professional growth thrive. 
 Join us to build more than digital solutions: help shape the future of our manufacturing operations and develop the talent that will drive this transformation forward. 
 The position is based at our Longueuil location, from Monday to Friday, with flexible hours and exclusively on-site.
 What will your day-to-day look like? 
 Define and evolve the Digital Manufacturing strategy and capability roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities and manufacturing performance objectives. 
 Lead, engage, and develop a multidisciplinary team of emerging talent and experienced professionals, fostering mentorship, collaboration, and a high-performance culture. 
 Guide and prioritize the digital product and capability portfolio, assess investment opportunities, and maximize business value across the organization. 
 Coach and support Product Managers, and Business Value Stream Managers to ensure alignment of roadmaps, priorities, and expected business outcomes. 
 Champion and drive the harmonization of manufacturing processes and digital capabilities across sites, while considering their specific operational needs. 
 Establish and monitor key performance indicators, business objectives, and benefit realization plans to measure the impact of digital initiatives. 
 Foster strong, collaborative relationships with stakeholders across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Digital Technology, promoting trust, mutual understanding, and cross-functional alignment to drive shared priorities and enable effective strategic decision-making. 
 Ensure alignment between strategy, business needs, and solution implementation by partnering with transformation, program delivery, and organizational development teams. 
 What do you need to be successful? 
 Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 Experience: Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in a manufacturing environment, including at least 5 years in team management, digital transformation, or strategic leadership. 
 French and English proficiency: Advanced proficiency in both spoken and written French and English to effectively collaborate with internal teams and partners at both local and international levels. 
 Leadership and engagement: Demonstrated experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to inspire, influence, and align stakeholders around shared objectives. 
 Strategic vision and business acumen: Ability to develop strategies and roadmaps, manage digital product portfolios, prioritize investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes. 
 This position is part of a French-speaking work environment, it requires a very good knowledge of English to read and understand, on a daily basis, documentation and technical terms that may emanate from international organizations, as well as to write and communicate in English with customers, suppliers or international colleagues.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Digital Manufacturing expertise: Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, digital technologies, and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution/Operations Management (MES/MOM) systems. Experience in systems integration, traceability, or manufacturing data management is considered an asset. 
 Collaboration and transformation: Excellent communication, complex problem-solving, and change management skills, combined with a mindset focused on innovation, process harmonization, and continuous improvement. Experience in multi-site environments and knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or Agile methodologies are considered assets.

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Overview

As our VP of Sales - Global Public Sector, you will spearhead year-over-year global revenue growth by developing and executing on enterprise level PUBSEC customer acquisition strategies. You will drive long-term success through strategic development, coaching, and expanding Cohere’s presence in the public sector. In this pivotal leadership role, you will cultivate and guide our sales team to exceed revenue targets and organizational goals, while fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

As our VP of Public Sector Sales you will:

 - Develop, execute, and lead a comprehensive, global go-to-market growth strategy and sales plan for the Public Sector, driving revenue growth and market expansion working with other regional sales teams.

 - Provide sales and operational leadership to Cohere’s  PUBSEC sales team, ensuring alignment with company objectives and priorities.

 - Partner with Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams to synchronize sales efforts with broader company goals.

 - Represent Cohere at PUBSEC industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities, as well as with regulators and government agencies, in collaboration with other regional and global leaders in Cohere.

 - Manage and nurture relationships with government decision-makers and partners to ensure Cohere’s success in the region. Identify and pursue new business opportunities, negotiating and closing high-value deals.

 - Collaborate with global teams to strengthen anchor relationships and establish best practices for enterprise-level project implementations, ensuring strong client engagement throughout project lifecycles.

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


WHY THIS ROLE?

We’re building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most driven, and most curious people to help us do it. As the head of the Data Foundation pillar of our Analytics and Data Insights team, you’ll lead the team that makes Cohere’s data trustworthy, governed, and available: the warehouse every analytics surface runs on, the pipelines that keep it fresh, the access model that keeps it secure, and the agentic analytics layer that lets anyone at Cohere (and their agents) ask questions of governed data directly.

Your team owns the full data lifecycle. You’ll run ingestion into BigQuery from internal and external data sources, orchestrate it in Airflow and Cloud Run, model the data warehouse in dbt, and serve the results through Looker, export APIs, and customer-facing analytics surfaces. Everything is provisioned as code in Terraform, and governance is part of the design: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, and documented access paths that let people and agents move fast without putting data at risk.

This role is both highly visible and highly impactful, and you’ll inherit a solid structure on which to build the rest of the stack: a Terraform-provisioned warehouse framework, dbt modeling conventions, an alerting and incident-response practice, and documentation patterns to keep everything discoverable. The roadmap is set with big bets in flight: scaling that framework across the company, standing up an internal analytics agent with a real eval harness, and consolidating institutional knowledge into a self-correcting and self-maintaining system that keeps context centralized, current, and documented, rather than dispersed and in people’s heads.

Responsibilities

As the head of the Data Foundation pillar, you will:

 - Build and lead the team. Hire and grow a team of data and infrastructure engineers; set the technical bar; develop strong talent and raise team performance, building leadership capability beneath you.

 - Set the roadmap from company strategy. Own and sequence the Data Foundation roadmap: the warehouse buildout, the agentic analytics program, data governance, and the platform work that unblocks our other pillars. You’ll make the trade-offs and carry the cross-functional impact that comes with them.

 - Own the data platform end to end. Ingestion (managed connectors and an open-source connector framework), orchestration on Airflow and Cloud Run, warehouse modeling in BigQuery with dbt (raw, core, mart layers), and serving through Looker, export APIs, and semantic layers. All of it provisioned as code in Terraform.

 - Own data governance. Define how humans, service accounts, and agents get access to governed data: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, documented onboarding paths, audit logs, and sensitive requests (including legal holds) handled to deadline.

 - Operate for reliability. Run the alerting and anomaly-detection framework, own data freshness SLAs, lead incident response and postmortems, and turn every incident into a durable standard so the same class of failure doesn’t recur.

 - Lead the agentic analytics program. Wire the semantic layer into an internal analytics agent, build the eval harness that measures its accuracy, and make the eval-driven call on where AI earns its way into production. Apply the same discipline to automating data engineering work itself.

 - Set the standard for analytics across the company. The medallion framework, naming conventions, and testing patterns your team maintains become the way other teams ship analytics data. You’ll onboard new domains onto it and keep the docs accurate to how the systems actually work.

 - Partner across the org. Work with the North product and engineering teams on the analytics surfaces that ship in the product (including a customer-facing analytics export), with Business Insights on marts for the business, with Security on data governance, and with Legal on compliance-critical data requests.


QUALIFICATIONS

You may be a good fit, if you have:

 - 10+ years of experience across data engineering, data infrastructure, or analytics platform work, with a strong management track record leading data platform or infrastructure teams

 - Serious hands-on history in data engineering or infrastructure before management. You can still read a Terraform plan, a dbt DAG, or an Airflow scheduler log and ask the question that matters

 - Production experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar), workflow orchestration (Airflow or similar), and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar)

 - Depth in data modeling: you think in fact and dimension tables, raw/core/mart separation, and semantic layers, and you have opinions on where tests and contracts belong

 - A record of setting a team’s roadmap from company or function strategy and delivering outcomes that span teams, with the cross-functional partnerships to match

 - Operational excellence you can point to: alerting you trust, SLAs you meet, incidents you run to ground and write up so they teach

 - Exposure to data security and governance: IAM, access management, VPC service controls or equivalent, audit and compliance workflows

 - Genuine excitement about AI: you follow the research, have opinions, and are energized by building the data foundation an AI company (and its AI agents) runs on

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity, leading a multi-workstream roadmap, and working directly with executives on priorities

If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply!

Il assure le leadership technique et administratif des projets en veillant au respect des exigences des clients, des budgets, des échéanciers et des standards de qualité de l’entreprise.
En plus de ses responsabilités en gestion de projet, il contribue activement à la conception et au développement des solutions techniques. Il agit comme principal point de contact auprès des clients, des sous-traitants et des équipes internes afin d’assurer l’exécution efficace des projets, de la définition des besoins jusqu’à la mise en service des équipements.
The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and execution of custom automated and robotic equipment projects. The incumbent provides both technical and administrative leadership, ensuring compliance with customer requirements, budgets, schedules, and company quality standards.
In addition to project management responsibilities, the Project Manager actively contributes to the design and development of technical solutions. Acting as the primary point of contact for customers, subcontractors, and internal teams, the incumbent ensures the efficient execution of projects from requirements definition through equipment commissioning. 
 Job Description 
 Principales responsabilités 
 Participer à l’analyse des besoins et des requis des clients. 
 Évaluer les projets, préparer les estimations de coûts et rédiger les propositions techniques et commerciales. 
 Planifier, coordonner et superviser l’ensemble des activités liées aux projets. 
 Élaborer et maintenir les échéanciers de projet et assurer le suivi de leur avancement. 
 Assurer le contrôle et le suivi des budgets, des coûts et de la rentabilité des projets. 
 Préparer les ETC (estimations à compléter) et produire les rapports de suivi requis. 
 Organiser et animer les réunions de lancement, les rencontres de suivi client et les ateliers de travail.

 Participer à la résolution des enjeux techniques et à l’amélioration continue des solutions développées. 
 Superviser les travaux effectués sur les sites des clients lors de l’installation des équipements.

 Assurer la satisfaction du client tout au long du cycle de vie du projet.

 Baccalauréat en génie mécanique, électrique, automatisation ou dans une discipline pertinente, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience.

 Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décision. 
 Leadership mobilisateur et habiletés reconnues en coordination d’équipes multidisciplinaires. 
 Bonne connaissance des normes de sécurité des machines CSA Z432 et CSA Z434. 
 Expérience en gestion de projets techniques dans un environnement manufacturier ou industriel. 
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en relation client. 
 Grande autonomie, sens des responsabilités et esprit d’initiative. 
 Bonnes compétences en planification, organisation et gestion des priorités. 
 Aptitudes marquées pour le travail d’équipe et le mentorat de personnel moins expérimenté. 
 Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement technologique innovant et en constante évolution. 
 Intérêt soutenu pour les projets complexes et diversifiés. 
 Orientation client et souci de la qualité des résultats. 
 /
 Project Manager

Job Description Summary 
We are seeking a Portfolio Projects Finance Leader to lead finance support across multiple Electrical Power Transmission project portfolios in the NAM region. This role will serve as a key finance partner to business and operations leadership, driving portfolio profitability, cash flow generation, execution discipline, and financial visibility across a large and complex backlog.
The role requires a strong combination of financial expertise, operational partnership, and cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will provide portfolio-level oversight of project financial performance, strengthen forecasting and governance processes, identify risks and opportunities early, and help drive actions that improve margin, cash conversion, and overall portfolio outcomes.
This role also provides functional leadership across project finance activities, ensuring consistency in financial reviews, forecasting rigor, performance management, and financial discipline across the portfolios. 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Serve as the finance leader across multiple Electrical Power Transmission project portfolios in the NAM region
 Partner with project management, operations, commercial teams, factories, and customer-facing teams to drive strong execution and financial performance across the portfolio landscape
 Drive portfolio profitability, margin performance, cash generation, and working capital improvement
 Lead portfolio-level financial reviews, including forecasting, budgeting, risk and opportunity assessments, and action planning
 Consolidate, challenge, and improve project and portfolio forecasts to ensure accurate visibility to revenue, cost, margin, and cash outcomes
 Provide financial leadership and business insight to support operational decision-making, portfolio prioritization, and performance improvement
 Partner with factories and execution teams to improve cost control, schedule performance, and delivery execution
 Work with customer-facing teams to improve billing milestones, collections, claims management, and overall cash conversion
 Identify, assess, and escalate portfolio risks and opportunities, ensuring timely mitigation actions and strong follow-through
 Strengthen financial operating rigor, process compliance, governance, and standardization across the projects organization
 Provide functional leadership, guidance, and coaching to Projects Finance Leaders and project finance teams across assigned portfolios
 Drive continuous improvement in project financial reviews, reporting quality, forecasting accuracy, and portfolio performance management
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Accounting, or a closely related field
 Minimum of 10 years of experience in project finance, operations finance, or business finance leadership
 Strong understanding of project-based financial management, including profitability, revenue recognition, cost control, forecasting, cash flow, and working capital
 Demonstrated experience supporting large, complex project or portfolio environments
 Strong analytical, financial modeling, forecasting, and problem-solving skills
 Proven ability to influence and partner across cross-functional teams in a matrixed operating environment
 Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with senior business, operations, and commercial stakeholders
 Experience in industrial, infrastructure, energy, or other project-based businesses preferred

 Strong finance leader with an operational mindset and a bias for action
 Effective business partner who can connect financial insights to execution and business outcomes
 Results-oriented, with a strong focus on profitability, cash generation, and performance improvement
 Comfortable operating across multiple portfolios and managing a high level of complexity
 Proactive, disciplined, and able to drive accountability across cross-functional teams
 Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence decisions and align stakeholders
 Able to balance strategic portfolio oversight with detailed operational follow-up
 Why this role matters 
 This role plays a critical part in improving business performance across a large-scale projects portfolio by bringing strong financial leadership, execution discipline, and portfolio visibility. The Portfolio Projects Finance Leader helps ensure the business delivers on its commitments for growth, profitability, and cash while strengthening financial rigor across the organization.

 Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde. 
 Un employeur de choix  
 Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale. 
 Dates du stage : 5 janvier au 23 avril 2027.
 Emplacement  : Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Longueuil du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.
 Consultez notre chaîne YouTube  :   https://www.youtube.com/@PrattWhitneyCa  
 Notre site web  :     https://www.pwc.ca/fr  
 Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe ?  
 Le candidat sera un composant actif de l'équipe de recherche et technologie en charge du déploiement de l'AM pour la production dans nos moteurs commerciaux. Notre équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec les concepteurs, les analystes, les ingénieurs de fabrication, les ingénieurs de matériaux et les spécialistes de procédé. Le candidat travaillera principalement dans un environnement de bureau extrêmement interactif avec une relation directe et le soutien total d'ingénieurs de haut niveau. Notre équipe est dynamique, agile et travaille sur des livrables formels de grande valeur. Horaire de travail flexible. Possibilité de télétravail.
 Le candidat participera au déploiement de la fabrication additive pour la réalisation de pièces de moteurs de production et, à ce titre, sera exposé à la totalité de la chaine de valeur de la certification d'un composant de moteur. Le candidat sera un élément actif d'une équipe dévouée et devra jouer un rôle proactif. Le rayonnement du candidat à l'extérieur de l'équipe et ses possibilités d'apprentissage ne seront limités que par sa motivation et sa volonté d'apprendre.
 À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien ?  
 Le poste est dans l’équipe de Fabrication Additive, sous le département de Technologie du Produit, afin d’assurer la gestion et la progression de projets en technologie de la Fabrication Additive. Vous serez un leader actif dans le déploiement des connaissances, des outils, des systèmes et des contrôles afin d’incorporer des pièces de fabrication additive sur nos moteurs de production.
 Le candidat sera en mesure de contribuer dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants, en fonction de ses préférences ou de ses compétences.
 1) Gestion de projet technologique: coordonne l'exécution de plusieurs projets AM, la création d'analyses de rentabilité, la validation d'outils de coût, la création de documents de communication à la haute direction, la planification et le déploiement de formations, etc.
 2) Développement de matériaux: participe à la caractérisation de matériaux en créant des plans de test, coordination d'essais mécaniques, analyse de données de test et création de rapports.
 3) Conception: évaluer les pièces pour la fabrication AM, proposer et créer des modifications de design. Créer et documenter les meilleures pratiques de conception AM. Création de documents de formation et offrir du support aux designers.
 Comme membre de l'équipe de déploiement stratégique, le candidat participera aussi à la coordination et la documentation de plans stratégiques, de matériel de vulgarisation de la technologie et de présentations aux exécutifs.
 Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ?  
 Être éligible à travailler au Canada.
 Être inscrit dans une université canadienne pendant toute la durée de votre stage.
 Être en mesure de travailler sur place dans la province où vous êtes embauché, le cas échéant.
 Habileté en modélisation 3D, idéalement sur le logiciel CATIA.
 Expérience en conception et fabrication de pièce par fabrication additive.
 Compréhension des différents procédés manufacturiers en aéronautique (usinage, moulage, etc.)
 Connaissance de base en métallurgie
 Bilingue Français/Anglais tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit
 Fortes habiletés en communication.
 Capacité à gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément
 Excellente aptitude en résolution de problèmes
 Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une connaissance fonctionnelle de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre des instructions spécialisées, des plans, des dessins et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et parfois communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.
 Travailler chez Pratt & Whitney Canada  
 Le masculin est utilisé sans discrimination et uniquement dans le but d’alléger le texte.  Nous étudierons la demande d’emploi de tous les candidats qualifiés. 
 Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, nous allions avec passion, audace et rigueur pour concevoir, fabriquer et entretenir les moteurs d’aéronefs les plus avancés et les plus fiables au monde. Notre travail et la qualité de nos produits contribuent au succès de nos clients, qui à leur tour sauvent des vies, soutiennent le commerce, connectent les communautés et protègent les libertés. 
 Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, vous avez l’occasion de faire une différence tous les jours ; il suffit de lever les yeux. Êtes-vous prêt à vous dépasser ? 
 Le candidat retenu devra se soumettre à une vérification de ses antécédents judiciaires et obtenir toutes les autorisations nécessaires en lien avec la manipulation et le transfert de marchandises contrôlées. L’offre d’emploi est conditionnelle à la réussite de ces vérifications et à l’obtention des autorisations requises. Si ces conditions ne sont pas respectées, l’offre d’emploi sera retirée.  
 _________________________________________________________________________
 About Pratt & Whitney Canada  
 Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) is a global leader in aerospace innovation, proudly headquartered in Longueuil, Quebec, since 1928. We design and manufacture next-generation aircraft engines that power the world’s largest fleet of business, general aviation, and regional aircraft and helicopters. 
 For nearly 100 years, our teams have been at the forefront of propulsion technology, pushing boundaries to make flight more efficient and reliable. Our engines support missions that truly matter, from transporting people and essential goods, to enabling emergency medical services, humanitarian operations, and wildfire suppression around the world. 
 An Employer of Choice  
 Pratt & Whitney Canada was named one of Canada’s Best Employers for 2026 by Forbes, marking the 11th consecutive year the company has earned this recognition. Pratt & Whitney Canada also ranked #1 employer in the aerospace and defense industry in the country. In addition, our headquarters continue to be recognized among the top employers in the Montreal region. Together, these distinctions reinforce our reputation as an employer of choice in Montreal, across Canada, and around the world. 
 Internship dates : January 5th to April 23rd, 2027.
 Location: The position is based at our Longueuil location; internship from Monday to Friday, with flexible hours and exclusively on-site.
 Check out our YouTube channel:     https://www.youtube.com/@PrattWhitneyCa  
 Our website:   https://www.pwc.ca/en  
 Why join our team?  
 The candidate will be an active component of the Research and Technology team in charge of deploying AM for production in our commercial engines. Our team works in close relationship with designers, analysis, manufacturing engineers, material engineers and process specialist. The candidate will mostly do office work in an extremely interactive environment with direct relationship and full support from senior engineers. Our team is dynamic, clever and works on high value hard deliverables. Flexible hours are a fact, remote work a possibility.
 The candidate will be participating in the deployment of AM for production engines, and as such will be expose to the full value stream of flight certification of an engine component. The candidate will be an active component of a really dedicated team and will be expected to take a pro-active role. Exposure and learning will only be limited by the candidate drive and willingness to learn.
 What will your day-to-day look like? 
 The position is in the Additive Manufacturing team, under the Product Technology department, to manage and drive the progression of Additive Manufacturing Technology projects. You will be an active leader in deploying the knowledge, tools, systems, and controls to incorporate AM production part in our engines. 
 The candidate will be able to contribute in one or more of the following fields, according to their preferences or competencies.
 1) Technology Project Management: coordinate the execution of multiples AM projects, creation of business cases, validation of costing tools, creation of communication documents to company executives, planning and deployment of training, etc.
 2) Material Development: participate in material characterization by creating test plans, coordinating coupon testing, analyzing material data, and creating material testing reports.
 3) Design: Evaluate parts for AM manufacturing, propose, create design changes. Create and document AM design best practice. Create training documents and support designers.
 As part of the main strategic team, the candidate will also participate in the coordination and documentation of strategic plans, technology awareness material and presentations to executives.
 What do you need to be successful?  
 Be eligible to work in Canada.
 Be enrolled in a Canadian university throughout your internship.
 Be able to work on-site in the province where you are hired if applicable.
 Skills in 3D modeling, ideally with CATIA
 Experience in designing and manufacturing of AM parts
 Understanding of the different aerospace manufacturing processes (machining, casting, etc.)
 Basic knowledge in metallurgy
 Spoken and written French/English bilingual,
 Strong and clear communication skills.
 Ability to handle multiple tasks at the same time.
 Excellent problem-solving skills.
 Although this position is part of a French-speaking work environment, it requires a working knowledge of English to read and understand specialized instructions, plans, drawings and technical terms that may emanate from international organizations, as well as to write and sometimes communicate in English with customers, suppliers or international colleagues.
 Working at Pratt & Whitney Canada

 At Pratt & Whitney Canada, we combine passion, boldness, and precision to design, manufacture, and maintain the most advanced and reliable aircraft engines in the world. Our work and the quality of our products contribute to the success of our customers, who in turn save lives, support commerce, connect communities, and protect freedom. 
 At Pratt & Whitney Canada, you have the opportunity to make a difference every day—just look up. Are you ready to go beyond?
