jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic Platform
jobs.loc: United States / New Jersey / Boston / Canada / New York / Washington, DC / Ottawa / Toronto / Montreal
jobs.desc:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


ABOUT NORTH:

North https://cohere.com/north is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.



WHY THIS ROLE?

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications.

We’re looking for Software Engineers with Applied AI experience who can own the design, build, and deployment of agentic workflows powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), from early prototypes to production-grade AI agents, to deliver concrete business value in enterprise workflows. You’ll work closely with customers on real-world business problems, often building first-of-their-kind agent workflows that integrate LLMs with tools, APIs, and data sources. While our pace is startup-fast, the bar is enterprise-high: agents must be reliable, observable, safe, and auditable from day one.

Note: between 20 - 40% travel anticipated.



IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Work closely with our enterprise customers to translate high-value, ambiguous business problems into well-framed agentic workflows with clear success criteria and evaluation methodologies

 - Lead the design, build, and delivery of LLM-powered agents that reason, plan, and act across tools, APIs, and sensitive enterprise data sources, with enterprise-grade reliability and performance

 - Build and ship features for North, our AI workspace platform, working across the full product lifecycle from conceptualization through production

 - Take ownership of scoping and shaping use cases end-to-end, flexing into whatever technical area the problem demands (including frontend) to drive the most effective solution

 - Contribute to shared frameworks and patterns that enable consistent, high-quality delivery across customers and teams

 - Drive clarity in ambiguous situations, build alignment, and raise engineering quality across the organization

 - Travel up to 20–40% to work on-site with customers and partners



YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You have hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade software in Python; you write clean, testable, observable, scalable code

 - You've built and deployed highly performant RAG and agentic applications, including agents that plan and execute multi-step tasks using patterns like ReAct or Plan-and-Execute

 - You're deeply familiar with the LLM stack: frontier models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks

 - You have a proven ability to build robust evaluation frameworks, moving well beyond trial and error, to measure agent accuracy, safety, and latency

 - You’re experienced working directly with customers and can lead technical discussions with enterprise stakeholders, translating ambiguous business needs into concrete technical specs

 - You have experience owning the full scope of a use case end-to-end

 - You thrive in fast-paced and ambiguous environments and can execute well even when priorities are shifting



IT'S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE:

 - Experience setting architectural standards for AI and agentic systems across distributed teams

 - Experience flexing into unfamiliar technical areas, such as frontend, when the problem calls for it

 - Exposure to regulated or sensitive industry environments (finance, healthcare, telecoms)

 - Experience with enterprise security, compliance, or auditability requirements for AI systems
   
   




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.desc:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime. 
 About the Role 
 Hasbro is seeking a Principal SAP Security Analyst to join our IT Security team in Montreal. This senior individual contributor position will assist in steering access governance, role development, compliance readiness, and security controls across SAP ECC, S/4HANA, SAP RISE, SAP Business Technology Platform, Identity Authentication Service, and Identity Provisioning Service.
 We are shifting more SAP security responsibility internally and need someone who can guide complex tasks through knowledge, collaboration, and sound judgment. This role is not a people manager position, but it does provide technical direction to SAP analysts, access administrators, project teams, business partners, auditors, and implementation partners.
 What You’ll Do 
 Build SAP security architecture, standards, access models, and role design practices.
 Support our migration to SAP RISE, including role mapping, identity integration, access transition, privileged access, connectivity, and post-migration controls.
 Develop and enhance Role-Based Access Control models that uphold least-privilege, address business needs, and meet compliance requirements.
 Lead role cleanup, redesign, simplification, and Segregation of Duties remediation.
 Set up and maintain SAP Identity Access Governance and SAP Governance Risk and Compliance, covering connectors, workflows, risk rules, provisioning, access analysis, and reporting.
 Strengthen access provisioning, access reviews, emergency and privileged access oversight.
 Support SOX and IT General Controls by collecting evidence, conducting audit walkthroughs, resolving issues, and providing clear documentation.
 Review access risks, weak role builds, SoD conflicts, insecure configurations, and control gaps.
 Partner with finance, supply chain, HR, procurement, SAP application teams, enterprise architecture, identity teams, cybersecurity, compliance, audit, and external partners.
 Provide technical mentorship without formal people-management responsibility.
 What You’ll Bring 
 6–8+ years of SAP security, access governance, role development, or related experience.
 Solid understanding of SAP ECC and S/4HANA authorization concepts.
 Experience in configuring or supporting SAP GRC and SAP Identity Access Governance.
 Familiarity with SAP BTP, IAS, IPS, and SAP RISE security considerations.
 Knowledge of Role-Based Access Control, Segregation of Duties, privileged access, user lifecycle management, and access reviews.
 Experience assisting with SOX, IT General Controls, internal audit, or external audit activities.
 Ability to guide complex initiatives, communicate clearly, and build trust with technical and business partners.
 Preferred Experience 
 SAP security certification or related SAP certification.
 Experience securing SAP RISE environments hosted on AWS or SAP-managed cloud infrastructure.
 Experience with S/4HANA migration, ERP modernization, hybrid SAP landscapes, or cloud identity integration.
 Experience in managing emergency access, conducting access certification, automating provisioning, and handling privileged access controls.
 Experience in a global enterprise environment with complex business processes and audit needs.

Voici ta chance de façonner des expériences de jeu légendaires qui marqueront toute une vie. 
 À propos du poste 
 Hasbro est à la recherche d'un(e) analyste principal(e) de la sécurité SAP pour se joindre à son équipe de sécurité TI à Montréal. Ce poste de contributeur(trice) individuel(le) senior jouera un rôle clé dans la gouvernance des accès, le développement des rôles, la conformité et les contrôles de sécurité au sein des environnements SAP ECC, S/4HANA, SAP RISE, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), Identity Authentication Service (IAS) et Identity Provisioning Service (IPS).
 Alors que nous rapatrions davantage de responsabilités liées à la sécurité SAP à l'interne, nous recherchons une personne capable de diriger des initiatives complexes grâce à son expertise, sa collaboration et son jugement. Ce poste ne comporte aucune responsabilité de gestion de personnel, mais il offre une orientation technique aux analystes SAP, aux administrateurs des accès, aux équipes de projet, aux partenaires d'affaires, aux auditeurs ainsi qu'aux partenaires d'implantation.
 Vos principales responsabilités 
 Concevoir et faire évoluer l'architecture de sécurité SAP, les normes, les modèles d'accès et les pratiques de conception des rôles.
 Soutenir la migration vers SAP RISE, notamment en ce qui concerne le mappage des rôles, l'intégration des identités, la transition des accès, les accès privilégiés, la connectivité et les contrôles post-migration.
 Développer et améliorer les modèles de contrôle d'accès basé sur les rôles (RBAC) afin de respecter le principe du moindre privilège, de répondre aux besoins de l'entreprise et de satisfaire aux exigences de conformité.
 Diriger les initiatives de nettoyage, de refonte et de simplification des rôles ainsi que la remédiation des conflits liés à la séparation des tâches (SoD).
 Configurer et administrer SAP Identity Access Governance (IAG) et SAP Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), y compris les connecteurs, les flux de travail, les règles de risque, l'approvisionnement des accès, l'analyse des accès et les rapports.
 Renforcer les processus d'attribution des accès, les revues périodiques des accès ainsi que la gouvernance des accès d'urgence et des accès privilégiés.
 Soutenir les exigences SOX et les contrôles généraux TI (ITGC) en recueillant les preuves d'audit, en participant aux revues d'audit, en résolvant les écarts et en produisant une documentation claire.
 Évaluer les risques liés aux accès, les rôles mal conçus, les conflits de séparation des tâches, les configurations non sécurisées et les lacunes de contrôle.
 Collaborer avec les équipes des finances, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des ressources humaines, des achats, des applications SAP, de l'architecture d'entreprise, de la gestion des identités, de la cybersécurité, de la conformité, de l'audit ainsi qu'avec les partenaires externes.
 Offrir un mentorat technique et guider les équipes sans responsabilité officielle de gestion.
 Ce que vous apporterez 
 De 6 à 8 ans ou plus d'expérience en sécurité SAP, gouvernance des accès, développement des rôles ou dans un domaine connexe.
 Solide compréhension des concepts d'autorisation SAP ECC et SAP S/4HANA.
 Expérience dans la configuration ou le soutien de SAP GRC et de SAP Identity Access Governance (IAG).
 Bonne connaissance des considérations de sécurité liées à SAP BTP, IAS, IPS et SAP RISE.
 Connaissance des principes de contrôle d'accès basé sur les rôles (RBAC), de la séparation des tâches (SoD), de la gestion des accès privilégiés, de la gestion du cycle de vie des utilisateurs et des revues d'accès.
 Expérience de soutien aux activités liées à SOX, aux contrôles généraux TI (ITGC), aux audits internes ou externes.
 Capacité à piloter des initiatives complexes, à communiquer efficacement et à établir des relations de confiance avec des partenaires techniques et d'affaires.
 Atouts 
 Certification SAP en sécurité ou toute autre certification SAP pertinente.
 Expérience en sécurisation d'environnements SAP RISE hébergés sur AWS ou dans une infrastructure infonuagique gérée par SAP.
 Expérience de migrations vers SAP S/4HANA, de modernisation d'ERP, d'environnements SAP hybrides ou d'intégration des identités infonuagiques.
 Expérience de la gestion des accès d'urgence, des campagnes de certification des accès, de l'automatisation de l'approvisionnement des accès et des contrôles des accès privilégiés.
 Expérience dans une entreprise d'envergure mondiale comportant des processus d'affaires complexes et des exigences d'audit importantes.
 Égalité des chances et mesures d'adaptation

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.desc:
Description 
 Taiga Motors, a rapidly growing off-road electric vehicle technology and manufacturing company, is seeking a highly motivated Manufacturing Engineer to design, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes for our production facilities. jobs.title: Développeur.euse de Communauté Senior (Projets non annoncés)
jobs.desc:
Le.la Développeur.euse de Communauté Senior joue un rôle de premier plan dans l’élaboration de stratégies mondiales d’engagement communautaire visant à favoriser la fidélisation des joueurs, tant au sein qu’en dehors de leurs expériences avec nos jeux. Il.elle sera chargé.e de mettre en place et de développer nos communautés mondiales autour des jeux d’Ubisoft, en faisant preuve d’une grande maîtrise de la communication avec les joueurs, de l’amélioration des jeux et des cycles de rétroaction, ainsi que du déploiement et du maintien des pratiques exemplaires. En tant que partenaire stratégique clé, il.elle donnera la priorité aux occasions de croissance d’affaires à l’échelle mondiale en collaborant avec des intervenants de divers secteurs, tout en dirigeant la stratégie communautaire mondiale, en élaborant et en mettant en œuvre des plans globaux, et en travaillant avec une équipe internationale décentralisée qui se consacre à établir des relations et à gagner la confiance des joueurs partout dans le monde. Le.la titulaire de ce poste mettra également son expertise au service de ses pairs et des membres des équipes interfonctionnelles afin de favoriser la planification collaborative, de développer de solides synergies et de respecter les engagements selon des normes de qualité élevées. En tant que leader au sein de l’équipe de la communauté mondiale, le.la titulaire de ce poste travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les principaux studios de développement.
  
 CE QUE VOUS FEREZ 
 Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans stratégiques communautaires à l’aide de diverses tactiques de contenu qui soutiennent les objectifs de production et renforcent la stratégie globale de marketing.
 Coordonner la communication, les activités et les initiatives avec plusieurs services à l’échelle mondiale afin d’assurer la cohérence et l’uniformité des messages.
 Tirer parti des gestionnaires de communauté, des équipes transversales et des ressources des partenaires pertinents pour créer du contenu pertinent pour nos joueurs (par exemple : blogues, balados, entrevues, infographies, etc.).
 Agir à titre de porte-parole pour la ou les marques assignées. Coordonner des événements axés sur la communauté, notamment, mais sans s’y limiter : des visites de studio par des fans, des dialogues avec les développeurs et des tournois.
 Collaborer avec le gestionnaire des médias sociaux du portefeuille pour définir et rendre compte des indicateurs de performance clés (IPK) liés au contenu, afin de démontrer le succès et le rendement du capital investi (RCI) des programmes communautaires et du contenu.
 Appuyer les étapes clés internes et externes, telles que les versions bêta et les lancements, afin de s’assurer que les IPK sont atteints et de défendre l’expérience des joueurs.
 Agir à titre de principal représentant des besoins des joueurs au sein des équipes de production et d’édition afin d’influencer positivement le développement et le positionnement en matière de communication, au nom de nos joueurs et de nos objectifs d’affaires.
 Façonner les cycles de rétroaction des joueurs et fournir des informations pertinentes aux équipes de production et d’édition afin d’influencer l’expérience de jeu, de favoriser la fidélisation des utilisateurs et de contribuer au positionnement des messages et des stratégies de marketing.
 Collaborer et coordonner avec les équipes opérationnelles pour la communication post-lancement. Définir les attentes concernant les situations pertinentes, telles que le contenu des mises à jour, leur statut et leur déploiement.
 Gérer et produire des rapports internes sur les commentaires, l’activité et les attentes de la communauté.
 Agir à titre d’expert reconnu en la matière, tant pour le projet que pour l’équipe communautaire mondiale au sens large, et jouer le rôle de mentor auprès des gestionnaires de communauté et de ses pairs.
 Adopter une approche axée sur le rendement du capital investi (RCI) en prenant des décisions réfléchies qui favorisent l’efficacité tout en faisant un usage stratégique des ressources disponibles.
 Jouer un rôle de premier plan dans la définition des pratiques exemplaires afin de maximiser l’impact et les partager de manière proactive avec l’ensemble de l’équipe communautaire.
 Identifier et tirer parti des occasions de synergies entre les équipes interfonctionnelles.
 Mener des initiatives transversales pour soutenir les objectifs et les résultats clés du service.
 Des déplacements à l’étranger peuvent être requis.
CE QUE VOUS APPORTEREZ À L'ÉQUIPE 
 Vaste expérience dans la gestion de communautés en ligne et dans la direction de l’élaboration de plans ou de programmes stratégiques ayant connu un succès avéré.
 Vaste expérience dans l’industrie du jeu vidéo sur plusieurs plateformes, dans divers genres et dans le cadre de lancements de jeux AAA (obligatoire); une expérience avec des titres de fantasy ou de jeux de rôle constitue un atout majeur.
 Expérience de travail sur des projets non annoncés ou en phase initiale, avec une capacité avérée à faire preuve de discrétion et à adapter la stratégie à l’évolution des orientations créatives.
 Expérience dans des environnements de co-développement ou de projets tiers, en collaborant au-delà des frontières des studios afin d’harmoniser les efforts de la communauté avec les réalités de la production.
 Une connaissance approfondie des plateformes communautaires et des médias sociaux (Instagram, X/Twitter, Facebook, TikTok, Discord, etc.) est requise.
 Expérience de travail dans un environnement de production exigeant, caractérisé par de multiples échéances, objectifs et parties prenantes.
 Expérience avérée dans l’établissement et le maintien de relations à long terme avec des studios partenaires, des parties prenantes externes et les communautés de joueurs.
 Connaissance approfondie ou passion marquée pour les jeux de rôle occidentaux et les jeux fantastiques, ainsi qu’une solide compréhension de leurs communautés et des attentes des joueurs.
 Esprit résolument tourné vers la défense des intérêts des joueurs : capacité à recueillir, synthétiser et défendre les commentaires des joueurs auprès des partenaires internes et externes, et à les traduire en recommandations concrètes.
 Excellente compréhension des mécanismes permettant de favoriser la croissance d’une communauté de jeux vidéo et de maintenir cette croissance, ainsi que de l’élaboration de plans stratégiques d’engagement des joueurs.
 Capacité à établir une relation de confiance à long terme avec les joueurs, y compris dans le cadre de projets qui ne peuvent pas encore être entièrement divulgués.
 Expérience de travail dans un environnement de production exigeant, impliquant la gestion de multiples échéances, d’indicateurs de réussite et de parties prenantes interfonctionnelles.
 Avoir lancé ou soutenu activement un titre AAA en service continu et/ou un jeu en accès anticipé constitue un atout majeur.
 Maîtrise du français.

Le candidat idéal possédera une solide expertise en modélisation financière, un grand souci du détail, un esprit d'initiative et une capacité à évoluer efficacement dans un contexte d'incertitude. Doté d'une mentalité d'amélioration continue, il contribuera à la prise de décisions stratégiques chez Lyft. Outre l'analyse en appui à la prise de décision stratégique, ce poste comprendra également la gestion et le reporting des clôtures financières.
 Responsabilités: 
 Responsabilité des activités principales de planification et d'analyse financières (FP&A) : budgétisation, prévisions, analyse des écarts et reporting financier mensuel pour la direction.
 Soutien aux processus de clôture mensuelle : rapprochement des réalisations avec le budget, identification et explication des écarts, validation des provisions, coordination avec la comptabilité.
 Synthèse des données financières issues de sources multiples (Oracle, systèmes de gestion de flotte, données de compte de résultat) en modèles clairs et bien documentés.
 Maintien et amélioration des modèles de prévision financière et des processus de reporting.
 Identification et mise en œuvre d'améliorations de processus pour réduire les interventions manuelles, accroître l'automatisation et améliorer la précision et la transparence des données.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, North Admin

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



About North:

North https://cohere.com/north is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.



In this role, you will:

 - Build and ship features for North, our AI workspace platform

 - Develop autonomous agents that talk to sensitive enterprise data

 - Write and ship minimal code that runs in low-resource environments, and has highly stringent deployment mechanisms

 - As security and privacy are paramount, you will sometimes need to re-invent the wheel, and won’t be able to use the most popular libraries or tooling

 - You have strong coding abilities and are comfortable working across the stack.

 - You’re able to read and understand, and even fix issues outside of the main code base

 - You have built and deployed extremely performant client-side or server-side RAG/agentic applications to millions of users.

 - Bonus: You love art and have an eye for design and a creative mindset - A plus, if you have a portfolio, GitHub or other showcases of your projects.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



Role Overview:

We are looking for world-class research scientists and research engineers to build cutting-edge multilingual AI to serve the world!

At Cohere, we care deeply about building technologies that are broadly accessible and useful, regardless of language.  As a Member of Technical Staff on the Multilingual team, you'll be at the forefront of advancing language models that serve the world. You’ll push the boundaries of what's possible in natural language processing. This isn't just a technical role—it's an opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking research that will define the next generation of AI.




Key Responsibilities:

 - Lead the design and implementation of scalable solutions to improve multilingual LLM performance across a wide variety of skills – if we need it to make a great multilingual model, you can build it!

 - Is perfect for someone passionate about languages and AI, with a keen eye for detail and strong technical skills.

 - Offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge language technology, making a global impact.

 - Requires a self-starter who can work independently and deliver results efficiently.

 - Publish research findings and contribute to academic discourse in top-tier venues

 - Mentor junior team members and shape global best practices in multilingual AI / NLP
   
   

Qualifications:

 - PhD in Computer Science, Linguistics, or related field (or equivalent experience)

 - Proven track record in large-scale data processing and ML pipeline development

 - Expert in Python and software engineering best practice

 - Deep understanding of multilingual data challenges and NLP fundamentals

 - Passion for advancing language technology and making global impact

 - Strong publication record or demonstrated research potential

jobs.title: Directeur ou directrice principal(e) de produit, IA conversationnelle// Principal Product Manager- Conversational AI
jobs.desc:
À propos du poste

HTS Assist est l'assistant d'intelligence artificielle agentique de Hopper pour le voyage, qui résout de vrais enjeux clients comme les changements de vol, les annulations, les remboursements et les réservations, par clavardage et par la voix, pour certaines des plus grandes marques et entreprises de voyage au monde. La voix pose ses propres défis produit, de la latence et de l'alternance de la parole jusqu'au moment de l'escalade vers un humain, et ce poste couvre les deux volets avec la même rigueur. 

À titre de directeur ou directrice principal(e) de produit, vous serez responsable de l'agent orienté client de bout en bout : les conversations, l'interface et l'expérience que nos partenaires offrent à des millions de voyageurs. Il s'agit d'un poste délibérément axé sur le design, où vous serez la personne qui tranche les décisions de design au quotidien, en façonnant directement les parcours et les interfaces en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de design de nos partenaires et notre designer interne.


À quoi ressemblerait votre quotidien

 - Être responsable de la feuille de route de l'agent conversationnel orienté client, tant par clavardage que par la voix, de la couverture des intentions et de la conception des conversations jusqu'aux interfaces que nos partenaires intègrent dans leurs applications et leurs sites web

 - Établir la norme produit pour la voix en particulier, en couvrant la latence, l'alternance de la parole, la gestion des interruptions, la localisation, la voix en temps réel et la qualité de la reconnaissance et de la synthèse vocale, puisque la tolérance d'une personne au téléphone envers une mauvaise expérience est plus faible que celle d'une personne qui clavarde

 - Mobiliser les partenaires d'entreprise à travers la découverte, la définition des exigences et les décisions de lancement, en traduisant leurs besoins en choix de produit qui permettent à un seul produit de servir plusieurs partenaires

 - Collaborer avec l'équipe Solutions partenaires sur la mise en œuvre et l'intégration

 - Piloter le design au quotidien, en travaillant directement dans Figma pour produire des parcours et des maquettes, et collaborer avec l'équipe de design sur les livrables haute fidélité et de production

 - Construire des prototypes fonctionnels à l'aide d'outils de codage par IA lorsque cela est plus efficace qu'une spécification écrite, afin de tester des parcours de conversation et des concepts d'interface

 - Définir et défendre les seuils de qualité avec l'équipe d'évaluation, en couvrant le taux de résolution, le taux de confinement, la justesse des escalades et la qualité des conversations

 - Spécifier en détail le comportement de l'agent, y compris la résolution, le ton, la politique d'escalade, les garde-fous et les cas limites, et itérer à partir des données de conversations réelles

 - Rester proche des équipes GTM, Solutions partenaires et Succès client, afin de faire remonter les apprentissages du terrain vers la feuille de route

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

 - 8 ans ou plus d'expérience en gestion de produit, incluant une responsabilité de niveau principal ou de direction sur un produit orienté client, avec une expérience directe du lancement de produits conversationnels vocaux tels que les systèmes IVR, les robots vocaux ou l'automatisation vocale de centres de contact

 - Une responsabilité directe d'un produit vocal en production, pas seulement d'un produit conversationnel par clavardage ou par texte, avec une bonne connaissance des compromis liés à la reconnaissance et à la synthèse vocale, des seuils de latence et de la gestion de l'alternance de la parole ou des interruptions. Il s'agit d'une compétence exigée

 - Une aisance en design, à l'aise de manipuler des fichiers de design et de produire seul(e) des parcours et des maquettes de base dans Figma, ayant déjà agi comme responsable de design de facto au sein d'une petite équipe

 - La capacité d'écrire suffisamment de code pour faire fonctionner un prototype sans attendre un ingénieur ou une ingénieure, en intégrant les outils d'IA comme partie normale de sa façon de construire

 - Une expérience concrète en développement front-end, ayant déjà bâti ou lancé des interfaces web et étant capable d'échanger de façon crédible avec des ingénieurs

 - Une solide expérience auprès de clients d'entreprise, idéalement dans des industries réglementées, à façonner les exigences et les décisions de lancement au niveau du produit

 - Une approche axée sur les données, ancrée dans les mesures de service à la clientèle et d'automatisation, incluant la résolution, le confinement, la satisfaction client et la qualité des escalades

 - Une bonne connaissance pratique des produits basés sur les grands modèles de langage, incluant la conception des invites et des comportements, les pratiques de qualité en IA et leurs modes d'échec

Avantages sociaux

 - Une entreprise en démarrage bien financée et éprouvée, avec de grandes ambitions, un salaire compétitif et les avantages d'un régime d'options avant l'entrée en bourse

 - Hopper couvre 100 % des primes du régime d'assurance collective

 - Hopper offre une couverture d'assurance vie, invalidité de courte durée et de longue durée

 - Un compte de dépenses santé qui couvre les frais médicaux et dentaires admissibles

 - Tous les employés et leurs personnes à charge ont accès aux services de télémédecine de Dialogue

 - Tous les employés ont accès à un régime de REER avec retenues automatiques avant impôt

 - N'hésitez pas à nous poser des questions sur notre congé parental très généreux

 - Vacances illimitées

 - Allocation de voyage Carrot Cash

 - Accès à un espace de coworking à la demande via FlexDesk et une allocation pour le télétravail

 - Une culture entrepreneuriale où repousser les limites fait partie du quotidien

 - Communication ouverte avec la direction et les dirigeants de l'entreprise

 - De petites équipes dynamiques ayant un impact considérable

À propos de Hopper 
Chez Hopper, notre mission est de devenir la plateforme de voyage de référence à l'échelle mondiale, en propulsant l'application mobile et le site Web de Hopper ainsi que notre division B2B, HTS. Grâce à d'importantes quantités de données et à des algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique avancés, Hopper combine une offre d'agence de voyages de calibre mondial avec des produits fintech propriétaires pour offrir transparence, flexibilité et économies aux voyageurs du monde entier.

La plateforme Hopper dessert des centaines de millions de voyageurs et continue de gagner des parts de marché partout dans le monde, avec plus de 120 millions de téléchargements. Par l'entremise de HTS, notre division B2B qui représente plus de 75 % de l'entreprise, nous propulsons les canaux directs de partenaires comme Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada et bien d'autres.

Hopper a été nommée entreprise la plus innovante en voyage par Fast Company, se classe au troisième rang des plus grandes agences de voyages en ligne en Amérique du Nord, et a amassé plus de 750 millions de dollars américains en capital privé auprès d'investisseurs institutionnels de premier plan.

Embarquez avec nous!


Ce poste utilise des systèmes de prise de décision automatisée pour évaluer l'aptitude des candidats. Conformément à la réglementation locale, vous avez le droit de comprendre les principaux facteurs utilisés dans cette évaluation, de demander une correction de vos données ou de demander une révision humaine de toute décision automatisée. Pour exercer ces droits, veuillez communiquer avec recruiting@hopper.com privacy@hopper.com

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

About the role
HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving real customer issues like flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the largest travel brands and enterprises in the world. Voice carries its own product problems, from latency and turn-taking to escalation timing when a human is on the line, and this role owns both surfaces with equal depth.      

As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer. 


What would your day-to-day look like

 - Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites

 - Set the product bar for voice specifically, covering latency, turn-taking, barge-in handling, localization, realtime voice and ASR/TTS quality, since a caller's tolerance for a bad interaction is lower than a chat user's

 - Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners

 - Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding

 - Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets

 - Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas

 - Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality across both chat and voice

 - Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data

 - Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap

An ideal candidate has

 - 8+ years of product management experience, including principal or lead-level ownership of a customer-facing product, with direct experience shipping voice-based conversational products such as IVR, voice bots, or contact center voice automation

 - Hands-on ownership of a production voice product, not only chat or text-based conversational AI, with working knowledge of ASR/TTS tradeoffs, latency budgets, and turn-taking or barge-in design. This is a required skillset

 - Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team

 - The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build

 - Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly

 - Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level

 - A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality

 - Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes


Perks and benefits of working with us

 - Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

 - Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for the group insurance plan

 - Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage

 - HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses

 - All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue's telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere

 - All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay

 - Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Carrot Cash travel stipend

 - Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend

 - Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

 - Open communication with management and company leadership

 - Small, dynamic teams with massive impact
   

About Hopper
At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth: billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS's channels every year. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus booking travel alone.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider, including airlines, hotels, banks, and travel agencies, can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to see millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agency in North America, and 70% of our app customers are Gen Z and millennial travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Come take off with us!

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



About North:

North https://cohere.com/north is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.


Why this role:

The Data Abstractions & Tools team is the group inside North responsible for how users bring their data into the platform and put it to work. We own the systems that let users upload, organize, and share their files and knowledge bases, the framework for extending agents with skills and third-party integrations, and the data-sync pipeline that connects enterprise data sources to North's agents.

North connects to a growing set of external tools and data sources so its agents can act on a user's real workflow. This role owns the integration pipeline end-to-end: adding new integrations to the platform, helping other engineers do the same, and becoming the owner of the process that makes that repeatable. You will also create the evals and tests that make sure those integrations work as expected and keep working as the platform evolves.


In this role, you will:

 - Build new integrations (tools) on the North agentic platform, and maintain the ones already in production.

 - Own the integration pipeline: the process for adding a new tool, from design to shipping to ongoing maintenance.

 - Help other engineers add integrations of their own, and raise the bar for how the team does it.

 - Create evals and tests to make sure integrations work as expected and alert on regressions.

 - Tune tool descriptions to improve performance based on feedback and evals.

 - Use AI actively in your work, while staying accountable for the quality and reliability of what you ship.



You may be a good fit if:

 - You have shipped production code and are comfortable building integrations against external APIs.

 - You have a background in evaluating agentic systems (ideal), or at minimum know what an eval is and are comfortable with prompt engineering and tool-description tuning.

 - You excel in fast-paced environments and can execute while priorities are a moving target.

 - You bring high agency: you learn quickly and drive change without waiting for perfect instructions.

 - You've owned things end-to-end before and care about the quality of what ships, not just that it shipped.

 - You enjoy helping other engineers succeed, not just shipping your own work.



Working Location:

This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.desc:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

AI Foundations areas that we are currently focusing on include reinforcement learning, learning from demonstration, generative modeling, Bayesian inference, hierarchical learning, and robust evaluation.
 In this hybrid role, you will report to a Senior Director of AI Foundations

 Own the data recipe for Waymo’s Foundation Model pre-training and post-training
 Lead and drive science on best practices around clustering, filtering, de-duplication, long-tail data mining, memorization, etc. 
 Tech-lead a team of research engineers to build the data flywheel to enable the above from Waymo’s massive driving data
 Integrate emerging research from the broader community to do rigorous ablations and promising data research techniques. This includes scaling ladders for pre-training, data mix optimizations and RL recipes (preferences) for post-training. 
 Engage with the wider research community on best practices around data centric evaluation creation and refinement 
 Partner with engineering and research teams across Waymo to share recipes, techniques, and post-training best practices to accelerate our collective know-how
 You have: 
 PhD or Masters in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a similar technical field; with 3+ years of industry or post-doc research experience in Data-centric AI, Reinforcement Learning or Foundation Models
 Demonstration of original contributions to the field through high-impact publications (ArXiv, peer-reviewed conferences like NeurIPS/ICLR/CVPR), technical blog posts, or significant open-source contributions
 Proficiency and in-depth knowledge of the inner workings of an ML framework (e.g. Pytorch, JAX, Tensorflow)
 Deep learning experience, especially with generative models, e.g., LLMs/VLMs, and/or reinforcement learning
 We prefer: 
 Extensive experience working with data and recipes for large scale foundation models
 ML infra experience: training, evaluating and deploying ML models at scale

 Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance

 Holidays: 13 paid days per year

jobs.title: Data Annotation Specialist, Generalist
jobs.loc: Canada / Calgary / Winnipeg / Vancouver / Halifax / Edmonton / Toronto / Victoria / Montreal
jobs.desc:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

We are on a mission to build machines that understand the world and make them safely accessible to all. Data quality is foundational to this process. Machines (or Large Language Models, to be exact) learn in similar ways to humans, by way of feedback. By labelling, ranking, auditing, and correcting model output, you will improve Large Language Models' performance for iterations to come, thus having a lasting impact on Cohere's technology. We are hiring Generalist professionals with broad backgrounds that span multiple consumer-facing or personal domains.

This is a judgment-driven role, not passive data entry. You will review, assess, and provide structured feedback across a broad and evolving range of tasks, evaluating, stress-testing, and improving our models on English-language data spanning multiple modalities (text, image, and structured formats such as JSON, CSV/TSV, and Markdown). This is a great opportunity for professionals with strong analytical skills to contribute to high-impact annotation projects.

Please Note: This is a part-time independent contractor position available within Canada only. We seek candidates who can commit to 16 hours per week at a CAD $30/hour contract rate. This role is BYOD 💻 (Bring Your Own Device, laptop). This position is remote.

As an Data Annotation Specialist, you will:

 - Evaluate and rank model outputs: Complete preference and comparison tasks, assessing which responses best conform to project guidelines for accuracy, helpfulness, tone, and safety, and writing clear justifications for your judgments.

 - Stress-test and break models: Probe models adversarially to surface failure modes, unsafe behavior, and capability gaps, and document reproducible cases that engineering and research teams can act on.

 - Create datasets: Author high-quality prompts, responses, and exemplars to build training and evaluation datasets, following detailed specifications and editing machine-written or human-written outputs to standard.

 - Build and apply rubrics and taxonomies: Contribute to the design of grading criteria and rubrics, then apply them consistently to produce structured, high-quality annotations across task types.

 - Annotate and correct multimodal data: Label, audit, and rectify inaccuracies across text, image, and structured data, maintaining a high standard of data integrity and accuracy.

 - Calibrate and maintain consistency: Participate in calibration exercises and inter-annotator agreement checks to align on standards, and flag ambiguous or uncovered edge cases rather than guessing, since a single misjudgment replicated at scale degrades a model.

 - Adapt to experimental work: Take on new and evolving task types as project needs shift, applying sound judgment in areas where guidelines are still being developed.

 - Report on model performance: Surface and communicate quality and performance trends in model and agent behavior, giving cross-functional partners clear, well-evidenced feedback on where models succeed, fail, and degrade.

You may be a good fit if you have:

 - 1+ years of experience in AI data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, research, or a related analytical role, with exposure to quality assurance, and/or preference ranking.

 - Experience applying detailed guidelines to complex and often ambiguous content, with strong contextual and sociocultural judgment, sensitivity to nuance, tone, and register, and the ability to reason well in cases where there is no single correct answer.

 - Comfort with ambiguity: a willingness to flag unclear or uncovered edge cases rather than guess, and to work productively on novel, experimental tasks whose definitions are still evolving.

 - A sharp, curious eye for inconsistencies, subtle errors, and model failure modes, including the instinct to probe models adversarially and surface where they break. Familiarity with how large language models behave, such as hallucination, sycophancy, and instruction-following gaps, is a plus.

 - Excellent command of written English and strong reading comprehension, with the ability to clearly justify your evaluations, including why an output is correct or incorrect, high-quality or low-quality, and to write clear prompts and exemplars that explain your reasoning. Bonus points if you are fluent in another language!

 - Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, with the ability to maintain consistency across high-volume and monotonous tasks.

 - Comfort working with annotation platforms and structured formats such as JSON, CSV/TSV, Markdown, XML, and YAML.

 - Strong execution in a remote environment, including good time management, comfort using new tools, and the ability to work independently in a global, asynchronous team.

Candidate Journey

 - Initial Screening: Our Talent Team will review your application.

 - First Assessment: If selected to move forward, you’ll receive a multiple-choice assessment by email.

 - Second Assessment: Candidates who achieve a passing score will be contacted by a member of our team to complete a more comprehensive assessment focused on their area of expertise.

 - Video Screen: If selected to move forward, you’ll have a short video call with a member of our Operations Team.

 - Final: Selected candidates will receive an Independent Contractor Agreement.

As an independent contractor, you maintain control over how you complete your work and may work with multiple clients simultaneously, although we ask you to declare if any of these are with a direct competitor of Cohere and maintain IP confidentiality of the Cohere project. Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. Compensation for services is provided to contractors by contractors invoicing for services provided pursuant to the terms of our agreement with the contractor.

It is important to understand that as an independent contractor, continuous work is not guaranteed. The client-contractor relationship is fundamentally project-based, meaning engagements may be temporary, periodic, or intermittent based on our organizational needs and project availability. As an independent contractor, you should anticipate fluctuations in workflow and, therefore, compensation for services when Cohere does not require as many hours of services in a week.

Prospective candidates, please be advised: this role involves working with human-generated and model-generated tasks that may involve exposure to not safe for work (NSFW) text content as part of data annotation tasks, including explicit, offensive, or other inappropriate material.

As an independent contractor, you maintain control over how you complete your work and may work with multiple clients simultaneously. We request that you declare any external work relationships with Cohere’s direct competitors and always maintain the IP confidentiality of the Cohere project. Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. Compensation for services is provided to contractors by self-invoicing for services provided pursuant to the terms of our agreement with the contractor.

It is important to understand that, as an independent contractor, continuous work is not guaranteed. The client-contractor relationship is fundamentally project-based, meaning engagements may be temporary, periodic, or intermittent based on our organizational needs and project availability. As an independent contractor, you should anticipate fluctuations in workflow and, therefore, compensation for services when Cohere does not require as many hours of services in a week.

Prospective candidates, please be advised: this role involves working with human-generated and model-generated tasks that may involve exposure to not safe for work (NSFW) text content as part of data annotation tasks, including explicit, offensive, or other inappropriate material.

If the above qualifications do not perfectly align with your experience, we still encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Data Developer
Coordinateur Logistique Senior / Senior Logistics Coordinator
jobs.desc:
English to follow 
 À propos de Taiga   
Taiga est une entreprise canadienne qui réinvente les sports motorisés grâce à des véhicules électriques hors route révolutionnaires. Adoptant une approche d'ingénierie optimisée, Taiga repousse les frontières de la technologie électrique pour atteindre des rapports puissance-poids extrêmes et les spécifications thermiques nécessaires pour surpasser les véhicules à combustion haute performance. Les premiers modèles commercialisés sont des motoneiges et motomarines électriques répondant à la demande croissante des clients récréatifs et commerciaux cherchant de meilleures façons d'explorer les grands espaces, sans compromis. Plus d'infos: www.taigamotors.com 
 Pourquoi ce poste est fait pour vous 
Passionné(e) de logistique internationale, vous aimez la fluidité et la transparence des envois, régler les problèmes avant qu'on ne les remarque ? Ce rôle est pour vous!  
Chez Taiga, la logistique est au cœur de tout. Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique dans un environnement international stimulant, où votre expertise terrain sera reconnue et vous aurez un impact direct sur les opérations mondiales.  
Ce poste s'adresse à quelqu'un qui aime retrousser ses manches, fier d'un travail bien fait, et qui comprend que rigueur et responsabilité ne sont pas des contraintes mais les ingrédients d'une logistique efficace.  
Vous serez le/la référent(e) opérationnel(le) interne pour toutes les opérations logistiques mondiales (flux import, export, prestataires tiers) et le point de contact pour tous nos départements.  
 Responsabilités   
 Pilotage des opérations transport (import/export/prestataires tiers) 
- Prendre en charge de bout en bout chaque expédition et anticiper les aléas. 
- Gérer les situations délicates (litiges, avaries, erreurs de livraison) avec sang-froid, diplomatie et suivi sans faille jusqu'à résolution complète.  
- Communiquer avec toutes les parties prenantes avec clarté, professionnalisme et sens de la relation : adapter votre ton, désamorcer les tensions, construire des relations de confiance durables.  
- Solliciter et comparer les cotations transport pour chaque expédition selon les procédures et le panel de fournisseurs référencés.  
 Documentation import/export & conformité réglementaire  
- Préparer, vérifier et valider avec rigueur toute la documentation logistique : connaissement (B/L), lettre de voiture (CMR), déclarations douanières, carnets ATA, certificats d'origine, factures proforma, documents marchandises dangereuses (IATA/IMO/ADR).  
- Garantir la conformité réglementaire de chaque expédition, y compris pour les produits dangereux, avec la rigueur et fiabilité requises.  
 Systèmes & données transport (Oracle/NetSuite)  
- Saisir et maintenir toutes les données transport dans le progiciel (Oracle/NetSuite) avec fiabilité absolue : expéditions, transporteurs, tarifs, statuts, documents, codes douaniers, origines.  
- Veiller à ce que le système reflète en permanence la réalité terrain, sans écart, incohérence ou donnée manquante.  
 Suivi des envois & tableaux de bord 
- Concevoir et piloter des fichiers de suivi Excel avancés pour une visibilité optimale (formules, TCD, mises en forme conditionnelles) pour suivre les KPI : coûts, ponctualité, qualité de service, litiges.  
- Identifier les dérives, alerter la hiérarchie avec clarté et proposer des actions correctives concrètes, et prendre la responsabilité de leur mise en œuvre sur votre périmètre.  
 Contribution aux appels d'offres & relations prestataires 
- Contribuer activement, en alignement avec votre hiérarchie, aux appels d'offres transport : préparation des données de volumes, analyse comparative des offres, restitution de vos observations terrain sur la performance des transporteurs.  
- Participer aux revues de performance prestataires avec des retours structurés, documentés et ancrés dans la réalité opérationnelle.  
 Amélioration continue & projets 
- Proposer des améliorations concrètes sur les processus, la standardisation documentaire et l'efficacité opérationnelle.  
- Participer aux tests, formations et harmonisation des procédures lors des déploiements de nouveaux outils ou flux.  
 Qualifications 
 - Formation en logistique, transport, commerce international ou équivalent.  
- 5 à 7 ans d'expérience confirmée en logistique internationale, import/export et coordination transport, avec une pratique quotidienne, concrète et ancrée sur le terrain. 
- Maîtrise avancée des réglementations transport et douanières ; connaissance des marchandises dangereuses (IATA/IMO/ADR) appréciée.  
- Expérience de contribution aux appels d'offres transport en soutien à la hiérarchie : préparation de données, analyse comparative, restitution.  
- Bonne maîtrise des ERP, idéalement Oracle et/ou NetSuite.  
- Maîtrise avancée d'Excel (formules complexes, TCD, fichiers de suivi).  
- Sens aigu des responsabilités et de l'imputabilité.  
- Communiquant(e) exceptionnel(le) à l'écrit comme à l'oral.  
- Pro-actif(ve), rigoureux(se), autonome.  
- Capable de jongler avec de nombreux dossiers complexes simultanément, avec calme et discernement, même sous pression.  
- Bilingue français/anglais, niveau professionnel irréprochable à l'écrit et à l'oral dans les deux langues.  
 Avantages   
- Jouez un rôle essentiel dans la mise sur le marché des véhicules électriques tout-terrain.  
- Horaire de travail flexible et hybride.  
- Événements d'entreprise - barbecues, journées d'essai, etc.  
- Régime de santé complet.  
- REER collectif.  
 Taiga accorde une grande importance à la diversité dans l'embauche et dans sa main-d'œuvre, et accueille les candidatures de personnes ayant des origines, formations et expériences diverses. Nous reconnaissons les obstacles à l'égalité d'accès et nous efforçons d'embaucher des groupes sous-représentés dans l'industrie technologique. La diversité chez Taiga signifie favoriser un lieu de travail où les différences sont valorisées pour leurs contributions.  
 Nous vous remercions de l'intérêt que vous portez à TAIGA. Seules les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien seront contactées.   
 ***
 About Taiga 
Taiga is a Canadian company reinventing the powersports experience with revolutionary electric vehicles. Through clean-sheet engineering, Taiga pushes electric technology to achieve extreme power-to-weight ratios and thermal specs to outperform high-performance combustion vehicles. The lineup includes electric snowmobiles and watercraft for recreational and commercial customers seeking better ways to explore outdoors without compromise. More at www.taigamotors.com  
 Why this role is for you 
Passionate about international logistics? Love smooth, transparent shipments and solving problems before anyone notices? This role is for you. At Taiga, logistics is at the core. You'll join a dynamic team in a stimulating international environment, where your expertise is recognized and you have direct impact on global operations. This role is for someone who loves rolling up sleeves, takes pride in quality work, and knows rigor and responsibility are essential ingredients of effective logistics.  
You'll be the internal operational referent for all worldwide logistics (import/export and 3PLs) and the contact point for all departments.  
 Responsibilities   
 Transport Operations (import/export/3PL) 
- Own each shipment end-to-end: organize, track, follow up, coordinate with carriers, 3PLs, warehouse, customers, vendors.  
- Handle delicate situations (disputes, damages, delivery errors) with composure, diplomacy, and relentless follow-through to full resolution.  
- Communicate with all stakeholders clearly and professionally, adapting tone, defusing tensions, building lasting trust.  
- Request and compare transport quotes per shipment, following procedures and approved vendor panel.  
 Import/Export Documentation & Compliance 
- Prepare, verify, validate all logistics docs: B/L, CMR, customs declarations, ATA carnets, certificates of origin, proforma invoices, dangerous goods docs (IATA/IMO/ADR).  
- Ensure full regulatory compliance for every shipment, including dangerous goods, with rigor and reliability.  
 Systems & Transport Data (Oracle/NetSuite) 
- Enter and maintain all transport data in ERP (Oracle/NetSuite) with absolute reliability: shipments, carriers, rates, statuses, documents, HS codes, origins.  
- Ensure the system always reflects ground reality — no gaps, no missing data.  
 Shipment Tracking & Dashboards 
- Design and manage advanced Excel tracking files (formulas, pivot tables, conditional formatting) to monitor KPIs: costs, on-time delivery, service quality, disputes.  
- Flag deviations, alert management clearly, and own corrective actions within your scope.  
 Tenders & Carrier Relations 
- Actively contribute to transport tenders with management: prepare volume data, comparative analysis, and field-based feedback on carrier performance. 
- Participate in carrier performance reviews with structured, documented, operational insights.  
 Continuous Improvement & Projects  
- Propose improvements to processes, documentation standards, and efficiency.  
- Participate in testing, training, and procedure harmonization during new tool/flow rollouts.  
 Qualifications  
- Degree in logistics, transport, international trade, or equivalent.  
- 5 to 7 years confirmed experience in international logistics, import/export, transport coordination — hands-on, daily operational track record.  
- Advanced knowledge of transport and customs regulations; dangerous goods (IATA/IMO/ADR) a plus.  
- Experience contributing to transport tenders: data prep, comparative analysis, reporting.  
- Good ERP command, ideally Oracle and/or NetSuite.  
- Advanced Excel: complex formulas, pivot tables, operational tracking.  
- Strong accountability.  
- Exceptional communicator, written and verbal.  
- Proactive, rigorous, autonomous.  
- Able to manage many complex files calmly and with good judgment under pressure.  
- Bilingual French/English, full professional proficiency both written and spoken.  
 Benefits 
- Play a key role in bringing off-road electric vehicles to market.  
- Flexible and hybrid working hours.  
- Company events - barbecues, employee demo days, etc.  
- Comprehensive health plan.  
- Group RRSP.  
 Taiga values diversity in hiring and workforce, and welcomes applications from diverse backgrounds, education, and experience. We recognize barriers to equal access and strive to hire under-represented groups in tech. Diversity means fostering a workplace where differences are valued.  
 Thank you for your interest. Only selected candidates will be contacted.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Integrations
jobs.desc:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!




ABOUT NORTH

North is Cohere's agentic AI platform: it securely deploys AI agents and automations inside an organization's own infrastructure, combining generative and search models with customizable integrations to drive productivity at scale.




OVERVIEW

North is only as valuable as the systems it can reach - CRM, ITSM, productivity suites, data warehouses, knowledge stores, and identity. You'll own that integrations surface end to end.

It’s a dual mandate: own the integrations themselves (prioritize, ship, and drive adoption) and build the underlying platform capabilities they depend on when those don't yet exist.




OUTCOMES

 - Family of integrations that are adopted and driving customer value, measured by usage and retention.

 - Reusable, platform-level capabilities and a developer and partner on-ramp that scale across use cases.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define the integration ecosystem strategy for North - roadmap, catalogue priorities, and partner posture - anchored to customer demand and revenue.

 - Own North's integrations end to end, and partner with strategic customers to define transformative, integrations-based workflows.

 - Derive generic, platform-level capabilities (connector framework, auth and identity, tool-use, data sync, permissioning) where they don't yet exist, partnering with the core-experience team on shared work.

 - Collaborate with forward-deployed engineering to define how to evolve integration work into reusable product, to scope, sequence, and build it.

 - Define the developer and partner experience (APIs, SDKs, plugin model, docs) and instrument analytics to track adoption, time-to-stand-up, and retention.




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years in product management on platform / API, integrations, or developer / ecosystem products.

 - Track record shipping integration, connector, or platform products with real impact on adoption, expansion, or retention.

 - Experience working directly with high-stakes customers and ecosystem partners.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, auth, data models, and integration architecture; comfortable with first-party vs. partner vs. self-serve tradeoffs.

 - Analytical and metrics-first, and a strong cross-functional collaborator across engineering, design, and field / deployment teams.

 - Experience with AI-first product management.

 - Bias for shipping and iterating.

 - Experience with a least a few domains of: Agentic AI, LLMs, Automation, Productivity, Enterprise security and compliance.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.
